card.name: Warning phrases before a restriction
card.fires_on: Words that begin or sit inside a warning or restriction statement on a label or site notice, such as 'Do' starting 'Do not use', 'otherwise noted', or 'ON THIS SITE'. It also fires on 'certain' before a drug class.

modes.example: unless otherwise<< noted>>. All clinically important drug interactions
